name: Pair-a-Social
source:
Play as one of four content creators who work in various mediums and collab with your friends to try to make rent by the end of the month.

[From [url=https://jenndragon.itch.io/pair-a-social]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演在各种媒体上工作的四位内容创作者之一，并与你的朋友合作，尝试在月底之前赚取租金。

[来自[url=https://jenndragon.itch.io/pair-a-social]Itch.io[/url]]
